title: AlmanacRenderMetadata
description: Schema for almanac render metadata tracked in run.json

almanac_path.description: Relative path to almanac.html from research root

almanac_generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when almanac.html was generated

almanac_renderer_version.description: Version identifier of the renderer tool

pdf_path.description: Relative path to presentation.pdf from research root

pdf_renderer.description: Identifier of the PDF renderer used
